articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced that two abstracts detailing results from the Company’s ADDRESS-LC Phase 2 trial in Long COVID, and SUNRISE-PD Phase 2 trial of bezisterim in Parkinson’s Disease have been accepted for presentation at ANA2026 , the annual meeting of the American Neurological Association. Results of the two studies will be presented as posters during the conference. ANA2026 will be held in San Diego, CA from October 17-20, 2026. articles.summary: Phase 2 data from the ADDRESS-LC trial of Bezisterim demonstrated statistically significant improvements versus placebo across fatigue, post-exertional malaise, and objective cognitive measures in Long COVID patients with higher baseline symptom burden CARSON CITY, Nev., Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced the presentation of results from the Phase 2 ADDRESS-LC study (NCT06847191) evaluating bezisterim (NE3107) in patients with Long COVID at the 151st Annual Meeting of the American Neurological Association (ANA), held October 17–20, 2026, in San Diego, California. The study’s abstract was published in Annals of Neurology (Vol. 100, pp. S4–S375, https://doi.org/10.1002%2Fana.78378 ), in conjunction with the meeting.
